startingPart.content:

- Check the official opening times before setting out.
- Use the saved ideas when you have extra time.

startingPart.title: Before your first morning
startingPart.content:
This example balances a few planned visits with an easy way to change your mind. Read the notes at each stop, then adapt the timing to your own pace.

## Before you go
- Choose the places you care about most.
- Keep your transport and booking details together.
- Review the route rather than trying to fit in every idea.

### Make it yours
Change the dates, reorder a stop or return to your saved ideas. [Read Navio help](/help).
